story.headline: OpenAI paused new Pro $200 sign-ups. Existing subscribers keep their plan.

heroVisual.alt: Illustration of a magnifying glass examining the evidence behind an AI headline in a newspaper.

story.the_story:
OpenAI says it temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200, also called Pro 20X, on September 10. Pro 20X is OpenAI’s name for its ChatGPT Pro $200 tier. The pause applies if you are on Free, Go, Plus or Pro $100 and want to move into Pro $200.

This is a pause on joining or upgrading into that tier. It is not an automatic cancellation: OpenAI says existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual. Pro $100 remains available for a new upgrade.
story.laidies_read:
If you already pay for Pro $200, the Help Center says it keeps renewing as usual. But if you cancel, finish a downgrade, or a renewal failure ends the plan, OpenAI says you cannot buy Pro $200 again until the pause lifts.

If you were planning to upgrade, the Help Center says new moves into Pro $200 are paused. That is the whole consumer consequence: an active plan and a new purchase follow different rules right now.
story.what_this_means: Before you change or cancel Pro $200, read OpenAI’s pause FAQ. It says a scheduled cancellation or downgrade keeps Pro $200 active until the billing cycle ends; a change that takes effect ends it.
story.cocktail_party: “A Pro $200 sign-up pause blocks a new purchase or upgrade. It does not by itself cancel an active Pro $200 subscription.”
story.class_notes: A pause on new purchases and a change to an active subscription are different events. Working with AI 101: Trusting the Output and Checking It helps you check which event an official rule actually describes before changing something you already use.

universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: The current OpenAI Help Center policy and a September 11 Computerworld report were reread on September 12.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: OpenAI does not give a restart date in the reviewed policy, and the article makes no capacity or other-product claim.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A reader comparing plans before a busy work period may need to preserve an active Pro $200 subscription or understand why a new upgrade cannot proceed.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: The pause applies to people on Free, Go, Plus or Pro $100 who want to move into Pro $200, while existing Pro $200 subscribers are addressed separately.

universalAnswers.uncertainty: The reviewed sources do not establish when the pause will lift or any individual account outcome outside the stated subscription rules.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Before changing anything, open Settings → My Plan and check your current tier and the next scheduled change.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: Am I keeping an active subscription, trying to enter a paused tier, or making a change that could end my current tier?
